# Superfeet Worldwide

> > Superfeet manufactures premium orthotic insoles and shoe inserts engineered with biomechanical science to provide arch support, comfort, and pain relief for conditions like Plantar Fasciitis, IT Band Syndrome, and Achilles Tendonitis.

Founded by Dennis Brown and Dr. Chris Smith, Superfeet combines carbon fiber stabilizer technology with professional-grade orthotic support for athletic performance, workplace wellness, and everyday comfort. The company offers ME3D custom 3D-printed insoles using biometric foot scanning alongside their signature collections for walking, running, hiking, and all-purpose use.

- Superfeet insoles
